title: Add 'feature' RulesRecordKind + kindSchema
description:
Per ADR 0009, add a first-class `feature` record kind for class/subclass-granted features (Action Surge, Channel Divinity, Rage, ...), distinct from player-selected `feat`.

Scope:
- Add 'feature' to RulesRecordKind union in packages/core/src/rules/types.ts.
- Add a BASE_KIND_VALIDATORS entry (exhaustive Record forces this) in packages/core/src/rules/kindSchemas.ts, plus a validateDnd5eFeature validator. Feature links to its grantor via data.source (granting class/subclass record key) and the level gained; description text required.
- Extend the lookup_rules tool enum in packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolLookupRules.ts (inputSchema enum AND the JSON-schema enum block — two places).
- Decide whether to promote 'feature' on the root export (index.ts) — RulesRecordKind is already exported there; adding a union member is additive.

This is infrastructure only: no parser, no records emitted here. The feature parser is a separate bead.
acceptance_criteria:
- 'feature' is a member of RulesRecordKind and validated by BASE_KIND_VALIDATORS.
- A dnd5e feature validator enforces description + grantor/level linkage fields.
- lookup_rules accepts kind='feature' in both enum sites.
- Typecheck + tests pass.
- ADR 0009 referenced in the schema/validator code comments.
close_reason: Implemented in PR #109 (work/0m9-5-15-feature-kind): feature RulesRecordKind + validateDnd5eFeature + lookup_rules enum + RULES_RECORD_KINDS sync. Typecheck/tests/Biome green.
